subject: Log certificate errors in isCertValid (OpenSSL 4.0 only) (#4064)
reason: The change only alters server log messages inside isCertValid (src/tls.c): when X509_check_certificate_times() fails it now logs a specific message for an invalid notBefore/notAfter field instead of a numeric error code. The function returns false in exactly the same cases as before, so TLS acceptance/rejection behaviour, command replies, replication and persistence are all unchanged. The code is also gated to OpenSSL >= 4.0 builds. A log-wording-only change is not observable by the fuzzer's oracles (replies, ledger, deployment state, liveness), so no scenario is needed.
